background_story: Austin was a devoted new father, eager to support his partner, Emma, as she breastfed their newborn baby, Olivia. As a lactation consultant had recommended, Emma and Austin worked together to create a nurturing environment that would help stimulate milk production. Austin took on the role of chief household chef, whipping up lactogenic-rich meals and snacks, such as oatmeal cookies and lactation teas, to help Emma's body produce a bountiful milk supply. He also made sure Emma stayed hydrated and comfortable, often bringing her water and pillows during late-night feeding sessions. As the days passed, Emma's milk supply flourished, and Austin's loving support played a significant role in their breastfeeding success. His selflessness and dedication earned him the title of 'lactation superhero' in Emma's eyes.
